title: A user with the Organization Admin role could point the server or token URL of a Git Sync connection at a loopback or…
description: A vulnerability in Grafana allows a user with the Organization Admin role to configure a Git Sync connection's server or token URL to a loopback or internal address. This misconfiguration causes Grafana to send sensitive OAuth client secrets, tokens, or GitHub App private key-signed requests to that internal address, resulting in a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability.
